hard_statistic: 1545 estimated benevolence is not colonial proceeds; 1549 royalty debt is a contemporary claim with 'more than' operator, not audited revenue; new local Castle Trust £700 military expenditure is an unverified secondary account; Boulogne dispossession has no numerical estimate; never conflate a 5000-resident policy cap with proven removals.
